BOOK ONE · LESSON 099

Ow!

啊哟！

A dialogue lesson about reporting what someone says. Andy has slipped and fallen downstairs and hurt his back; Lucy tries to help him stand up, but he can't get up, so Lucy phones Dr. Carter, who says he will come at once. Lucy is sure that Andy needs an X-ray. New vocabulary includes ow, slip, fall, downstairs, hurt, back, stand up, help, at once, sure, and X-ray. Workbook practice covers filling in the missing words of the dialogue and matching words into pairs of opposites. Grammar exercises practise reported speech with 'that' (says/thinks/is sure/is sorry/believes/understands/knows), answering 'What's the matter?' using reported-speech clauses, and making sentences with the reported-speech structure 'verb + that + clause'.

READ & UNDERSTAND

Lesson 课文

Listen then answer this question. Must Andy go to see the doctor?
听录音，然后回答问题。安迪需要去看医生吗？

Listen to the recording and answer the question: Must Andy go to see the doctor?

  1. 1

    ANDY

    Ow!

    安迪：啊哟！

  2. 2

    LUCY

    What's the matter, Andy?

    露西：怎么了，安迪？

  3. 3

    ANDY

    I slipped and fell downstairs.

    安迪：我滑了一跤，从楼梯上摔下来了。

  4. 4

    LUCY

    Have you hurt yourself?

    露西：你摔伤了没有？

  5. 5

    ANDY

    Yes, I have.
    I think that I've hurt my back.

    安迪：是啊，摔伤了。我想我把背摔坏了。

  6. 6

    LUCY

    Try and stand up.
    Can you stand up?
    Here.
    Let me help you.

    露西：试试站起来。你能站起来吗？来，让我帮你。

  7. 7

    ANDY

    I'm sorry, Lucy.
    I'm afraid that I can't get up.

    安迪：对不起，露西。恐怕我站不起来。

  8. 8

    LUCY

    I think that the doctor had better see you.
    I'll phone Dr. Carter.

    露西：我想最好请医生来给你看一下。我去给卡特医生打电话。

  9. 9

    LUCY

    The doctor says that he will come at once.
    I'm sure that you need an X-ray, Andy.

    露西：医生说他马上就来。安迪，我看你需要做一次 X 光透视。

Notes on the text 课文注释

fell downstairs

fell downstairs, 从楼梯上摔下来。downstairs 是副词，修饰 fell，作状语。

Try and stand up.

Try and stand up. 试着站起来。在英语中，常用 and 把两个动词连接在一起，如第 13 课的 come upstairs and see it。这种句子往往用来鼓励某种动作。

Here.

Here 在这里是感叹词，意思是“来”或“喂”，引起别人注意。

Let me help you.

Let me help you. 让我来帮你。其中 let 有“允许”的意思。注意在 let 后面要加不带 to 的动词不定式。

The doctor says that he will come at once.

在英文中如果要把某人所说的话告诉另一个人，要用间接引语。间接引语不用引号，往往在引语前加 that 等引导词。
